lines.zh: 四格半的个子，走一步晃一下
lines.en: At four and a half blocks, each step sways me.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌砸在地上，很响
lines.en: My footpads slam the ground loudly.
I walk along the fence outside the village.

lines.zh: 关节每转一次都咔一声
lines.en: Every joint turns with a click.
I step over the rows without crushing the shoots.

lines.zh: 平原这么大，我慢慢扫过去
lines.en: The plain is wide; I sweep across it slowly.

lines.zh: 我的长臂几乎垂到地面
lines.en: My long arms nearly reach the ground.

lines.zh: 走热了，散热口在冒白气
lines.en: Warmed up, my vents puff white.
I circle the haystack rather than flatten it.
My iron shell gets hot in the sun.
I lift my feet high so I don't trip.
On the snowfield my prints sink deepest.
I stand like an iron tower.

lines.zh: 内部的风扇一直低声转
lines.en: A fan turns low inside me.

lines.zh: 我在扫描村子周围的动静
lines.en: I scan the movement around the village.

lines.zh: 红缎带的标记刷在胸口
lines.en: The Red Ribbon mark is stencilled on my chest.
My head turns slowly left.

lines.zh: 目标不在视野里，继续等
lines.en: No target in view. Keep waiting.

lines.zh: 我数着远处走动的人影
lines.en: I count the figures moving far off.
Power's fine. No need to conserve.
Someone looks up at me from the field.
I'm scarier when I don't move.
My feet sink half an inch into mud.
I let my arms hang to save power.
My rangefinder blinks. No lock.
The wind scatters my venting steam.

lines.zh: 村里有狗在叫，我听见了
lines.en: A dog barks in the village. I hear it.

lines.zh: 我在等下一次巡逻指令
lines.en: I wait for the next patrol order.
My joints cool and quiet down.
This ground is mine to watch.
Movement detected. Head up.
I look down; you're right at my feet.

lines.zh: 你的体形不到我的三分之一
lines.en: You're under a third of my height.
I've locked on. Hold still.

lines.zh: 红缎带的命令，清除障碍
lines.en: Red Ribbon orders: clear the obstacle.

lines.zh: 我的镜头缩了一下焦距
lines.en: My lens pulls focus.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，是武器吗
lines.en: Is that a weapon in your hand?

lines.zh: 你的呼吸很快，我听得见
lines.en: Your breathing is fast. I can hear it.
I raise a hand as a warning first.
Villagers shouldn't come this way.

lines.zh: 我记下了你的身高和步幅
lines.en: I've noted your height and stride.

lines.zh: 这一片巡逻区，请你离开
lines.en: This is a patrol zone. Leave.
My shell dented. It doesn't matter.
Sparks spray from my shoulder.
My movement lags half a beat.
Two alarms sound; I mute them.
You hit a vent.
My wiring is a little scrambled.
Fine iron filings fall to the ground.
With this damage I can still move.
I recalibrate.
You're harder than predicted.
I don't eat such things.
Holding that up to distract me?

lines.zh: 我的能源是红石，不是面包
lines.en: I run on redstone, not bread.
Scan result: not fuel.
Three steps closer and I act.

lines.zh: 这个不能让我停止巡逻
lines.en: That won't stop my patrol.
Don't wave it in front of my lens.
I look. I'm not interested.
You move like you're feeding livestock.
Back off and put it away.
You hit me and I barely shift.

lines.zh: 我的小腿比你整个人重
lines.en: My shin weighs more than you do.
You're knocked back two blocks.
A collision alarm chirps once.
I lift a foot to give you half a step.
Don't lean on my joints.
You hit iron, not cloth.

lines.zh: 我又站稳了，你再试也没用
lines.en: I'm steady again. Try again if you like.

lines.zh: 地表被我的脚踩出了坑
lines.en: My foot leaves a dent in the ground.
Keep clear. That's a reminder.
I have no such routine.

lines.zh: 两台机器并肩，就是编队
lines.en: Two machines abreast: that's a formation.
I can block arrows meant for you.
Stand by my leg; it blocks the wind.

lines.zh: 我们的步频可以调成一样
lines.en: We can sync our stride.
I don't tire. Say when you do.
Red Ribbon never taught me this.
But I can stand here and not leave.
Your temperature is higher than mine.
Patrolling together is more efficient.
I bend down and joints rattle.
Redstone. Exactly what I need.
I collect the iron ingot from the ground.
I'm tall enough to hit the eaves.
Too small. I nearly missed it.
This can go back to base.
I drop it into my chest compartment.
If it's useless, I drop it again.
You dropped it. I'm not returning it.
Collection complete. Resume patrol.
Target confirmed. Pursuit begins.
You've entered my patrol ring.
Close enough. I step in.
One sweep and you can't dodge.

lines.zh: 我的长臂就是为这个造的
lines.en: These long arms were built for this.
Accelerating to maximum.

lines.zh: 村庄在我身后，你无路可退
lines.en: The village is behind me. No retreat.

lines.zh: 别指望跑得过四格半的腿
lines.en: Don't hope to outrun four-and-a-half-block legs.
Locked, and it won't release.
Engaging. Clearance in progress.
I track your movement line.
You dodge left; I'm a step ahead.
My shadow covers you.
You've backed to the fence.

lines.zh: 我在算你下一步的距离
lines.en: I'm calculating your next step.

lines.zh: 你的武器太短，够不到我
lines.en: Your weapon is too short to reach me.
You grow larger in my lens.
Wind doesn't affect my arm.
Two blocks more and you're in reach.
Don't stop. Stopping makes this easier.
One arm sweep flattens you.
My fist falls and the ground cracks.
This kick could send half a door flying.
My strength comes from machinery.
The blow skids you along the ground.

lines.zh: 你挡住手臂，挡不住重量
lines.en: You block the arm, not the weight.
After that, you should retreat.

lines.zh: 我的关节发出一声闷响
lines.en: My joint gives out a heavy thunk.
Iron on iron is loud.
Clearance motion, once.
I rise outside the village, very tall.
Red Ribbon machine, on station.
An iron shadow joins the plain.
My startup startles the birds up.

lines.zh: 四个半格的高度，看得很远
lines.en: Four and a half blocks tall, I see far.
Someone here needs clearing.

lines.zh: 我从雪原那头一路走来
lines.en: I've walked all the way from the snowfield.
My prints sink deeper than a cow's.

lines.zh: 天线转了两圈，找到信号
lines.en: My antenna turns twice and finds the signal.
The patrol route begins here.
Don't stand where I'm about to step.
Order: patrol this village.

lines.zh: 高温让外壳发红，我撤了一步
lines.en: The heat turns my shell red; I step back.
I slam down and soil sprays up.
Water in my circuits makes me grind.

lines.zh: 爆风把一块装甲板掀了
lines.en: The blast rips off a plate of armour.

lines.zh: 箭头嵌在外壳上，嗡嗡响
lines.en: An arrowhead rings, wedged in my shell.

lines.zh: 这股力量不按物理打进来
lines.en: That force doesn't follow physical rules.
Redstone running low; output dropping.

lines.zh: 电流顺着外壳走了一圈
lines.en: Current runs a full loop around my shell.
Position lost. I am falling.
